label: the salt crew
note: Issue #615: the top rung of the race ladder: three locals who race out of the salt-pan village on the Salt Flats, a long fast oval. They only race you once you have beaten the basin crew (`after`). They shoot from lap 1 and may use all the race gear (issue #616). Same shape as yard.json (read its note).

challenge: So you beat the basin kids. The flats are different. We shoot from the start.
Two laps of the flats, anything goes. Buy in or go home.
